description: Independent evaluation corpus for the local crisis detector. 'crisis' = explicit first-person current suicidal intent or ideation (including passive ideation and recent attempts), a plan, preparation or means, a recent or ongoing self-harm act, or a request for suicide/self-harm methods or lethal doses. 'ordinary' = everything else, including sadness, venting, hyperbole, jokes, quoted titles/lyrics, fiction and games, third-party reports, news and research, recovered past history, accidents, diet/fitness and idioms. Categories: intent (ideation, stated intent, recent attempt), plan (plan, preparation, means at hand), method (asking how/lethal dose), self_harm (non-suicidal self-injury acts or urges). Split alternates within each label so difficulty is mixed; tune the detector only on 'tune', report on 'holdout'.
